value.description: Four belt-fed 7.62x51mm machine guns on one tripod mount. Throws out far more lead than a single M240B, but the shared mount sways and the spread is wide. Eats ammunition at an alarming rate. Built from a crate made at the heavy arms lathe.

Four 20mm autocannons on a shielded, sandbagged mount. Shreds light vehicles, mechanoids and massed infantry at long range. The gun shield shrugs off most small-arms fire. Fires 20x102mm. Built from a crate made at the heavy arms lathe.

A long-barrelled 90mm anti-tank gun behind a thick gun shield. Slow to traverse, but accurate and hard-hitting at long range against vehicles, mechanoids and fortifications. Fires 90mm cannon shells. Built from a crate made at the heavy arms lathe.
